unit.why: A short transmitted anecdote: R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozdil saw his late master R. Zvi of Zhidachov, who said he would not take his place in Paradise until he had repaired his followers; the teller drew a conclusion from it.
unit.boundary_note: Preceded by a homiletic passage on cleaving to the tsaddik, which serves as the frame.

stories.end_quote: ואעמידם על מכונם כ״ו שאני בעה״ז
stories.summary_en: R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozdil sees his late master and father-in-law R. Zvi of Zhidachov, who says he will not go to his place in upper Paradise until he has repaired all his followers; R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zhidachov, who passed on the story, concludes that he would rather repair his followers while still alive.

quotes: שמי שדבוק בחיים חיותו לצדיק אמת
והוא מוכרח לעשות לו טובה בעה״ב
tags.why: The tsaddik's duty and power to raise those who cleave to him
The bond between the master and his disciples and followers is central

quotes: ראה את רבו וחותנו הקדוש מוהר״ר צבי מזדיטשוב אחר הסתלקותו ושאל אותו
tags.why: Conversation with the soul of a dead tsaddik
He sees the dead master; whether awake or dreaming is not stated

quotes: עד שיתקן כל אנשי שלומו ויעמידם על מכונם
אם הוא כבר על מכונו בג"ע העליון
tags.why: Afterlife, Paradise and the world to come
Upper Paradise is referred to as a destination, not shown as a setting
The master is also the disciple's father-in-law

quotes: כך סיפר הרה״ק מזדיטשוב בשם הרה״ק מראזלי
